title: Host-formatted issue ids in @kanbus/ui (formatIssueId hook) for Papyrus newsroom boards
description:
Requested 2026-10-20 by the Papyrus session. Papyrus newsroom boards run the 0.4.0 editorial themes on all four sites, but card and detail ids render like "CONTENTITEM:ITEM-ARTICL..." because packages/ui formats every id with formatIssueId (packages/ui/src/kanban/format-issue-id.ts) and the editorial themes uppercase the id line (packages/ui/src/styles/themes/editorial-base.css ~line 111). The design wants a quiet mono path such as "articles/agent-software-factory".

Work (spec first in packages/ui/features, steps in packages/ui/tests/steps.mjs, fixture in packages/ui/tests/fixture):
1. Add an optional host hook formatIssueId?: (issue: KanbanIssue) => string, provided once per board through a React context (exported provider, plus a formatIssueId prop on IssueCollection, Board, TaskDetailPanel and IssueDetailPanel that sets the context). Every place that renders an issue id uses it: IssueCard (packages/ui/src/kanban/IssueCard.tsx ~120), StatusTree (~160), TaskDetailPanel (~455 aria-label, ~467, ~1157), IssueDetailPanel, and any other id line found by grep. Without a host formatter the current formatIssueId(issue.id) output is the default, so the console is unchanged.
2. When a host formatter is supplied, the id element carries data-issue-id-format="host", and the theme CSS does not transform it: in editorial-base.css (and organizer.css if it uppercases ids) set text-transform: none for [data-issue-id-format="host"]. Keep the mono font and size.
3. Scenarios: default ids unchanged; a host formatter's output appears verbatim (case preserved, not truncated) on the card, in the status tree and in the detail panel, including the aria-label; the editorial theme does not uppercase host-formatted ids.
4. Bump packages/ui to 0.4.1 (package.json and package-lock.json) in the same PR and document the hook in packages/ui/README.md and THEMES.md.
Acceptance: packages/ui npm test passes; console typecheck and build pass; the console looks the same as before.
